notes: Six additions. Activity: one feed of what happened around the house - doors, alarm, locks, smoke/CO, leak, water main, comings and goings, power cuts, chores. Maintenance: recurring jobs (furnace filter, gutters, generator test) hang off House Wiki items, with due dates and a phone reminder. Stack Health (admin): backups, disks, certificates, DNS and every service on one page. Away mode: one switch arms the alarm, sets the thermostat back and pauses chores and the internet gate - it never disarms the alarm. Message board: pinned family notes on the hub and the wall kiosks. Install to phone: the hub is now a proper installable app. Note: Away mode is a new permission - grant it in Admin to anyone who is not an admin.
